examples.en: The fictional package identifies the degree as the principal course of study after the earlier preparatory course.
examples.zh: 虚构课程组合将预备课程之后的学位课程列为「主要就读课程」。

examples.en: We located the principal course of study in the classroom visa timeline before reading the provider transfer rule.
examples.zh: 在阅读教育机构转学规则之前，我们在课堂签证时间线上找出「主要就读课程」。

collocations: identify the principal course of study
start of the principal course of study
transfer during the principal course of study

words.enDefinition: two or more linked courses presented together as a sequence in the Australian Student visa context

examples.en: The fictional packaged courses include a preparatory stage followed by the higher education program named in class.
examples.zh: 虚构「组合录取课程」包括一个预备阶段，随后是课堂点名的高等教育项目。

examples.en: We drew both packaged courses on the same timeline to show their ordered start and completion dates.
examples.zh: 我们把两项「组合录取课程」画在同一时间线上，显示依序排列的开课及完成日期。

collocations: sequence of packaged courses
enrolment in packaged courses
documentation for packaged courses

words.enDefinition: a requirement for overseas students to make satisfactory academic progress under the relevant Australian condition or provider standard

examples.en: The classroom extract places the course progress requirement in the part covering ongoing contact with the education provider.
examples.zh: 课堂节选在涉及与教育机构持续联系的部分列出「课程进度要求」。

examples.en: We compared the course progress requirement with the separate attendance information in the fictional study record.
examples.zh: 我们将「课程进度要求」与虚构学习记录中另列的出勤信息作比较。

collocations: meet a course progress requirement
review a course progress requirement
evidence relevant to a course progress requirement

words.enDefinition: an obligation to meet an applicable attendance standard for a course when required by Australian overseas education rules

examples.en: The fictional policy lists the satisfactory attendance requirement separately from completion of assessed work in the course.
examples.zh: 虚构政策将「出勤达标要求」与完成课程考核任务分别列出。

examples.en: We read the classroom extract to see which hypothetical course had a satisfactory attendance requirement.
examples.zh: 我们阅读课堂节选，查看哪项假设课程设有「出勤达标要求」。

collocations: meet a satisfactory attendance requirement
applicable satisfactory attendance requirement
review a satisfactory attendance requirement

words.enDefinition: an Australian education provider's agreement to let an overseas student transfer under the relevant provider transfer rules

examples.en: The teaching example lists a release from a registered provider between the original course and the new provider.
examples.zh: 教学示例在原课程与新教育机构之间列出「原注册机构同意转学」。

examples.en: We identified the release from a registered provider and then read the separate offer from the new provider.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「原注册机构同意转学」的记录，再阅读新机构单独发出的录取通知。

collocations: grant release from a registered provider
decision on release from a registered provider
condition for release from a registered provider

words.enDefinition: a rule limiting transfers between registered Australian providers within a specified stage of an overseas student's study

examples.en: The classroom example asks which course stage the provider transfer restriction refers to in the fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 课堂示例问，「转学限制」涉及虚构时间线中的哪个课程阶段。

examples.en: The excerpt helped distinguish a provider transfer restriction from ordinary admission rules at the receiving college.
examples.zh: 我们用官方节选区分「转学限制」与接收学院的一般入学规则。

collocations: apply a provider transfer restriction
scope of a provider transfer restriction
exception to a provider transfer restriction

words.enDefinition: a change in whether or how a student is enrolled, potentially reportable in the Australian overseas education system

examples.en: The event log marks a change in enrolment status after the institution updated the fictional student's academic record.
examples.zh: 院校更新虚构学生学业记录后，事件日志标出一次「学籍注册状态变动」。

examples.en: We identified the change in enrolment status from the two different status labels in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂表格上，根据两个不同的状态标签辨认出「学籍注册状态变动」。

collocations: record a change in enrolment status
report a change in enrolment status
date of a change in enrolment status

words.enDefinition: a temporary pause in an existing enrolment recorded under the provider's applicable rules

examples.en: The sample timetable labels suspension of enrolment as a break after the fictional student's course had already begun.
examples.zh: 样例时间表将「暂停在读注册」标为虚构学生课程开始之后暂停的一段时间。

examples.en: We placed suspension of enrolment separately from cancellation on the display used in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习使用的显示图上，将「暂停在读注册」与取消注册分别标出。

collocations: record suspension of enrolment
period of suspension of enrolment
decision on suspension of enrolment

words.enDefinition: postponement of the start of a student's course or enrolment under the chosen provider process

examples.en: The sample record shows deferment of commencement before the hypothetical course was due to open in class.
examples.zh: 课堂样例记录显示，假设课程在原定开课前发生「推迟开始就读」。

examples.en: We distinguished deferment of commencement from suspension after enrolment began on the fictional chronology in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习的虚构时间顺序中，我们区分「推迟开始就读」与注册开始后的暂停。

collocations: request deferment of commencement
approve deferment of commencement
record the deferment of commencement

words.enDefinition: a notice recording that a student's enrolment has been cancelled, where relevant to an Australian education provider process

examples.en: The fictional enrolment cancellation notice states the provider's decision and identifies the relevant course on its first page.
examples.zh: 虚构「取消注册通知」在首页说明教育机构的决定，并标明相关课程。

examples.en: We read the enrolment cancellation notice and marked when the change reached the institution's administrative record.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「取消注册通知」，并标出该变更何时录入机构管理记录。

collocations: issue an enrolment cancellation notice
review an enrolment cancellation notice
date of an enrolment cancellation notice

words.zhGloss: 澳职业教育毕业工作类别
words.enDefinition: an Australian Temporary Graduate visa stream for eligible graduates with certain qualifications and subject to applicable criteria
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳职业教育毕业工作类别

examples.en: The classroom chart labels the Post-Vocational Education Work stream separately from the pathway for higher education graduates.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「澳职业教育毕业工作类别」与高等教育毕业生适用的类别分开标注。

examples.en: We read the official stream names before locating the Post-Vocational Education Work stream in the sample diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读官方类别名称，再在样例图中找出「澳职业教育毕业工作类别」。

collocations: eligibility for the Post-Vocational Education Work stream
application under the Post-Vocational Education Work stream
definition of the Post-Vocational Education Work stream

words.enDefinition: an intermediary representing or assisting students or providers with education recruitment and enrolment matters

examples.en: The fictional provider's document names an education agent who communicates with prospective students about course offerings.
examples.zh: 虚构教育机构的文件列出一位「教育代理」，负责与意向学生沟通所开设的课程。

examples.en: We distinguished the education agent from the government decision-maker in the classroom diagram of student applications.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂学生申请示意图中，区分了「教育代理」与作出决定的政府人员。

collocations: appoint an education agent
education agent agreement
responsibilities of an education agent

words.enDefinition: a person nominated to receive specified written communications from Australian immigration authorities on an applicant's behalf

examples.en: The sample file names an authorised immigration correspondence recipient for the fictional applicant's written notices.
examples.zh: 样例档案列出一位「移民函件授权接收人」，负责接收发给虚构申请人的书面通知。

examples.en: We checked which notices were addressed to the authorised immigration correspondence recipient in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中核对哪些通知寄给「移民函件授权接收人」。

collocations: nominate an authorised immigration correspondence recipient
notices sent to an authorised immigration correspondence recipient
contact details of an authorised immigration correspondence recipient

words.enDefinition: the formal submission of an application to the relevant authority in the prescribed process

examples.en: The specimen timeline marks application lodgement before assessment of the supporting information in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 样张时间线将「申请递交」标在虚构案例中审核证明资料之前。

examples.en: We compared the timestamp for application lodgement with an earlier date when the draft was saved.
examples.zh: 我们把「申请递交」的时间戳与较早的草稿保存日期作比较。

collocations: date of application lodgement
confirm application lodgement
record application lodgement

words.enDefinition: the status label shown for a lodged application in Australia's online immigration account system

examples.en: The fictional dashboard displays the application status in ImmiAccount beside the date of the last recorded change.
examples.zh: 虚构面板在最近一次记录变更的日期旁显示「ImmiAccount申请状态」。

examples.en: We read the application status in ImmiAccount separately from the simulated officer's later decision notice.
examples.zh: 我们分别阅读「ImmiAccount申请状态」与随后生成的模拟官员决定通知。

collocations: check the application status in ImmiAccount
change in application status in ImmiAccount
label showing application status in ImmiAccount

words.enDefinition: an application that meets the legal requirements for valid lodgement, separate from whether a visa can be granted

examples.en: The policy exercise distinguishes a valid visa application from an application that satisfies the criteria for grant.
examples.zh: 政策练习区分「有效签证申请」与符合获批标准的申请。

examples.en: We marked the question about a valid visa application before considering the fictional decision-maker's later assessment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在讨论虚构决定人员的后续审核前，先标出有关「有效签证申请」的问题。

collocations: make a valid visa application
requirements for a valid visa application
assess a valid visa application

words.enDefinition: an authorized official who makes a decision on a visa application under the applicable immigration law

examples.en: The exercise names the visa decision-maker in the administrative record, separate from the institution that offered admission.
examples.zh: 练习中的行政记录写明「签证决定人员」，并与提供录取的院校分开列示。

examples.en: We read which documents the visa decision-maker relied on in the hypothetical Australian decision summary.
examples.zh: 我们阅读假设澳大利亚决定的摘要，查看「签证决定人员」依据了哪些文件。

collocations: identify the visa decision-maker
findings of a visa decision-maker
reasons given by a visa decision-maker

words.enDefinition: reporting by Australian education providers through the Provider Registration and International Student Management System

examples.en: The instructor's diagram connects PRISMS reporting to the institution's record of the fictional student's enrolment change.
examples.zh: 老师的示意图将「PRISMS系统申报」与院校记载虚构学生学籍变动的记录联系起来。

examples.en: We distinguished PRISMS reporting from the personal visa status display on the other page of the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们将「PRISMS系统申报」与练习另一页上的个人签证状态显示区分开。

collocations: requirements for PRISMS reporting
event subject to PRISMS reporting
provider responsibility for PRISMS reporting

words.enDefinition: a failure to meet a condition attached to Student visa permission under the applicable legal framework

examples.en: The fictional record flags a possible student visa condition breach for discussion under the assigned Australian guidance.
examples.zh: 虚构记录标出一项可能「违反学生签证条件」的情形，供依据指定的澳大利亚指南讨论。

examples.en: We read the stated condition before classifying the model example as a possible student visa condition breach.
examples.zh: 我们先读明示条件，再判断示例是否可能属于「违反学生签证条件」。

collocations: alleged student visa condition breach
assess a student visa condition breach
consequence of a student visa condition breach

words.zhGloss: 澳海外学生教育法规框架
words.enDefinition: Australia's body of legislation and standards regulating education services provided to overseas students
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳海外学生教育法规框架

examples.en: The course summary uses ESOS framework for the laws and standards governing the fictional education provider's obligations.
examples.zh: 课程总结提到「澳海外学生教育法规框架」，指规范虚构教育机构义务的法规及标准。

examples.en: We opened the official guide to locate the ESOS framework provisions assigned for the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 我们打开官方指南，查找课堂对比指定的「澳海外学生教育法规框架」条文。

collocations: obligations under the ESOS framework
scope of the ESOS framework
ESOS framework guidance

words.zhGloss: 澳海外学生教育国家规范
words.enDefinition: Australia's national standards for registered providers of education and training to overseas students, made under the ESOS framework
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳海外学生教育国家规范

examples.en: The worksheet cites the National Code for overseas students beside a fictional example of provider transfer.
examples.zh: 习题在虚构机构转学示例旁引述「澳海外学生教育国家规范」。

examples.en: We looked up the National Code for overseas students headings before comparing the two sample institutional policies.
examples.zh: 我们在比较两项院校样例政策前，先查阅「澳海外学生教育国家规范」的标题。

collocations: standard in the National Code for overseas students
requirements of the National Code for overseas students
compliance with the National Code for overseas students
